scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @leave/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run start:dev --workspace @leave/api" "npm start --workspace @leave/web"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @leave/contracts && npm run test:cov --workspace @leave/api && npm test --workspace @leave/web -- --watch=false --coverage
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @leave/contracts && npm test --workspace @leave/api && npm test --workspace @leave/web -- --watch=false
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src packages/contracts/src scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @leave/contracts && tsc --noEmit --project apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.spec.json
